requirements.quote: Create a new UTF-8 encoded file `/home/user/releases/deploy_queue.json` containing only the rows from `deployments.csv` where the “status” column equals the literal string “pending”.

check.cmd: python3 -c "import csv,json;rows=[{k.strip():(v or '').strip() for k,v in r.items()} for r in csv.DictReader(open('/home/user/releases/deployments.csv',encoding='utf-8-sig'))];d=json.load(open('/home/user/releases/deploy_queue.json',encoding='utf-8'));p=[r for r in rows if r['status']=='pending'];assert [{k:str(v) for k,v in o.items()} for o in d]==p"

requirements.quote: The "pending" rows should be represented as an array of JSON objects.

check.cmd: python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('/home/user/releases/deploy_queue.json',encoding='utf-8'));assert isinstance(d,list) and all(isinstance(o,dict) for o in d)"

requirements.quote: Preserve the original column ordering as JSON keys in this order: `id`, `project`, `version`, `environment`, `status`, `release_date`.

check.cmd: python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('/home/user/releases/deploy_queue.json',encoding='utf-8'));assert d and all(list(o)==['id','project','version','environment','status','release_date'] for o in d)"

requirements.quote: The file must be pretty-printed with two-space indentation and must end with a single trailing newline (ASCII 0x0A).
The log MUST have exactly five lines, in the following order (all uppercase key names and “=” signs exactly as shown):

check.cmd: [ "$(grep -c '' /home/user/releases/deployment_summary.log)" -eq 5 ] && [ "$(cut -d= -f1 /home/user/releases/deployment_summary.log | tr '\n' ' ')" = 'TOTAL_RECORDS PENDING COMPLETED ABORTED GENERATED_AT ' ] && [ "$(head -n4 /home/user/releases/deployment_summary.log | grep -Ec '^[A-Z_]+=[0-9]+$')" -eq 4 ]

requirements.quote: The counts in `deployment_summary.log` are numerically correct relative to the original CSV.

check.cmd: python3 -c "import csv,json;rows=[{k.strip():(v or '').strip() for k,v in r.items()} for r in csv.DictReader(open('/home/user/releases/deployments.csv',encoding='utf-8-sig'))];L=open('/home/user/releases/deployment_summary.log',encoding='utf-8').read().splitlines();kv=dict(l.split('=',1) for l in L[:4]);c=lambda s:sum(r['status']==s for r in rows);assert kv=={'TOTAL_RECORDS':str(len(rows)),'PENDING':str(c('pending')),'COMPLETED':str(c('completed')),'ABORTED':str(c('aborted'))}"

requirements.quote: GENERATED_AT=<UTC ISO-8601 timestamp in the form YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ>
Each key/value pair must appear on its own line and the file must finish with a single trailing newline.
Both files are UTF-8 encoded and have one—and only one—trailing newline.

check.cmd:
python3 -c "[open(p,encoding='utf-8',errors='strict').read() for p in ('/home/user/releases/deploy_queue.json','/home/user/releases/deployment_summary.log')]" && [ "$(tail -c1 /home/user/releases/deploy_queue.json | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' 
')" = "0a" ] && [ "$(tail -c2 /home/user/releases/deploy_queue.json | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' 
')" != "0a0a" ] && [ "$(tail -c1 /home/user/releases/deployment_summary.log | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' 
')" = "0a" ] && [ "$(tail -c2 /home/user/releases/deployment_summary.log | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' 
')" != "0a0a" ]

requirements.quote: The original `deployments.csv` file must not be modified.
Also tidy up the host: delete the `/opt/orchid` directory and everything inside it.
